The Process

How a deal moves through EEMMIC.

EEMMIC is a platform, not an EPC — we don't build or own generation. Here's the four-stage process that takes a deal from inquiry to financed, verified delivery.

Evaluation → Management → Marketplace → Investment

The four stages

Stage 1

Evaluation

Verify Before Anyone Bids

Buyer side: pull the factory, hospital, or mall's electricity bills and load profile to size real demand. Supplier side: check each EPC's installed-MW history and authorizations. Regulatory side: confirm the structure is legal under NEPRA's net-billing rules and the relevant DISCO's interconnection requirements.

Stage 2

Management

Delivery Milestones

EEMMIC tracks the EPC's delivery milestones — design, procurement, installation, commissioning — against the timeline committed at bid stage, with documentation and DISCO/NTDC interconnection paperwork tracked centrally.

Stage 3

Marketplace

Competing Bids

A buyer posts a verified requirement; qualified EPCs submit competing bids on price, timeline, equipment, and warranty. The buyer compares bids on the platform — the win goes to the best-qualified bid, not the loudest sales call.

Stage 4

Investment

Financing the Deal

Once a buyer and EPC are matched and the deal is evaluated as real, banks or infrastructure funds review the same verified data EEMMIC used at Evaluation — reducing their own diligence cost.

The Buy Side

Who We Serve

EEMMIC's marketplace connects these buyers to verified EPC suppliers.

Industrial & Manufacturing

Textile mills, cement plants, and manufacturing facilities sizing captive solar against real load profiles.

Institutions

Hospitals and universities looking for reliable, net-billing-compliant power.

Commercial & Retail

Shopping malls and housing societies evaluating solar and storage for shared load.

This describes how EEMMIC's process is designed to work with qualified suppliers in Pakistan's solar EPC market — it is not a claim that any specific company is currently onboarded, under contract, or partnered with EEMMIC.
